```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

jaguars <- read_csv("jaguars.csv")

ggplot(jaguars, aes(x = Wins, y = `Passer Rating`)) +
  geom_point(color = "lightblue", size = 4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Year)) +
  labs(
    title = "Trevor Lawrence MVP Season",
    subtitle = "Wins vs QBR",
    x = "Wins",
    y = "QBR"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
Trevor Lawrence is having an MVP season, being top 5 in almost every passing stat. In his last 16 games, he has been taken out early in 8 of those games due to creating a huge lead against his opponentz. Playing the Titans this week, I am excited to watch Trevor Lawrence and the Jags put on a show and show why he deserves the MVP award this year.
